differences.published_behavior: Cache inputs and outputs describe in-place aliased allocations.
differences.native_behavior: Prepare copies input bytes. GPU kernels compute updated caches in owned output buffers. Read every present/cache output and feed the returned bytes into a new request for the next step. Caller host tensors are not mutated, and no aliased GPU-memory ABI is exposed.
differences.repeated_run_behavior: Each run reuses the prepared input snapshot and computes the same request; cache/state outputs are not implicitly fed back.
